subject.title: feat: add tools.fs.roots — per-agent filesystem roots with access modes

question: Should OpenClaw accept `tools.fs.roots` as the canonical host filesystem/media allowlist and expose `resolveAgentScopedOutboundMediaAccess` through the Plugin SDK after the explicit-root widening bug is fixed?
rationale: The line-level defect is mechanically fixable, but the broader host filesystem config, plugin SDK exposure, and operator upgrade contract are security/product choices automation should not settle.

options.title: Accept after boundary fix
options.body: Require the workspace-append fix, conflict resolution, and renewed FS/media/channel proof, then proceed with `tools.fs.roots` as the intended contract.

options.title: Narrow to media roots only
options.body: Reject the broad filesystem policy for now and route the remaining work through a smaller media-local-roots design tied to the open media issues.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Keep the related issues open while maintainers redesign the filesystem sandboxing contract before accepting a public config or SDK surface.

recommendation.title: Accept after boundary fix
recommendation.body: Require the workspace-append fix, conflict resolution, and renewed FS/media/channel proof, then proceed with `tools.fs.roots` as the intended contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent history across media roots, outbound access, and plugin SDK boundaries touched by the decision.
